## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-prv`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-prv -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `prv.json`
- `eval.yaml`
- `POINTER.txt`
- `items.jsonl`
- `provbench.py`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `provbench-n20.json`
- See the Data tab for all 14 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)
